sources.title: RICE: Simple prioritization for product managers
sources.author: Sean McBride / Intercom
sources.reliability: Authoritative for Intercom's heuristic; ordinal estimates are not objective utility or calibrated probabilities.
sources.notes: Full public article text read. Scores inform judgment; dependencies can justify a different sequence. Example scales are not universal benchmarks.
supported_claims: RICE combines reach, impact and confidence divided by effort
Ranking can be overridden for dependencies and essential requirements

sources.title: About North Star Framework
sources.author: Amplitude
sources.reliability: Official practitioner framework; analytics vendor, not independent efficacy research.
sources.notes: Public chapter read; whole playbook not read. Customer value, business outcomes and controllable inputs are connected as hypotheses rather than proven causal laws.
supported_claims: North Star represents customer value linked to business outcomes
Input metrics help teams understand how their work can influence it

sources.title: How time works in a retention analysis
sources.author: Amplitude Docs
sources.reliability: Authoritative for vendor-specific time windows; general measurement lesson requires matching business cadence.
sources.notes: Public text reviewed. Calendar dates and rolling 24-hour windows differ; project timezone affects calendar intervals.
supported_claims: Time-window definitions and timezone can change retention values

sources.title: Interpret your funnel analysis
sources.author: Amplitude Docs
sources.reliability: Authoritative for chart mechanics; a funnel association does not establish the cause of abandonment.
sources.notes: Public documentation read. Conversion window, entry criteria, ordering and counting conventions are essential. No vendor default adopted as a business benchmark.
supported_claims: Funnel conversion depends on event sequence and conversion window
Segment breakdown and conversion times help locate potential friction

sources.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
sources.author: Strategyzer; Alexander Osterwalder and collaborators (framework origin)
sources.reliability: Creator's official tool explanation; commercial page, no independent causal validation.
sources.notes: Public landing page read, not subscription playbooks. Customer jobs/pains/gains and offer-side value hypotheses are matched then tested; filled canvas does not establish PMF.
supported_claims: Describe one customer segment and its jobs, pains and gains
Map products/services, pain relief and gain creation

sources.title: Revenue recovery 101: A playbook for businesses
sources.author: Stripe
sources.reliability: Authoritative operational payment context; marketing claims and aggregate recovery statistics are not adopted.
sources.notes: Public text reviewed. Failed payments are one possible loss mechanism; retry outcomes and billing state must be inspected before labeling voluntary churn. Does not recommend any particular service purchase.
supported_claims: Unsuccessful payment collection can cause avoidable revenue loss
Recovery actions depend on the cause of the failure
